title: Item:Gold Seal Elixir of Healing
wikitext:
__NOTOC__{{Top}}
Gold Seal Elixirs of Healing provide a large instant burst of healing, followed by a heal-over-time effect that continues to heal for ten seconds. Function equally well on living creatures, constructs (warforged), and undead (pale masters) who use them. Can be used twice as often and come in several varieties:

== Regular vs Gold Seal elixirs ==

* Availability - Some of the stronger elixirs are only available in the Gold Seal variant.
* Binding - Regular elixirs are unbound, Gold Seal variety binds to account.
* Cooldown - Regular elixirs have a cooldown period of 30 seconds; it's halved to 15 seconds for Gold Seal elixirs.
* Minimum level - The minimum level increases with elixirs' potency for regular elixirs; all Gold Seal elixirs are ML:1.
* Weight - Gold Seal elixirs have no weight.
